content:
alex_growth: Quick turnaround ask — final pass on hero + CTA for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Dropping 3 micro-variants below. Need picks + lead routing for Dedicated demo requests. Short replies pls.

alex_growth: Hosted hero A: 'Build with an LLM API that scales from prototype to production.' Sub: 'Streaming, short-tail latency, usage-based pricing.' CTA: 'Start for free'

alex_growth: Hosted hero B: 'Production-grade LLM inference — no infra to manage.' Sub: 'Verified models • predictable latency • built-in caching' CTA: 'Try Hosted API'

alex_growth: Dedicated hero A: 'Reserved GPU capacity, predictable throughput.' Sub: 'Committed pools, autoscale, SLA-backed performance.' CTA: 'Request Dedicated quote'

alex_growth: Private hero A: 'Private inference behind your VPC.' Sub: 'KMS/HSM, air-gapped options, audit logs.' CTA: 'Contact sales for Private'

sarah_content: I like Hosted B. Cleaner for product-first buyers. Shorten sub like you have — that dot list reads well.

ben_design: For CTAs, primary for Hosted (Start free) and outline for Dedicated/Private (Request quote / Contact sales). I can do 2-button hero comps.

emily_seo: Small SEO note — include 'API' in Hosted H1 and avoid absolute phrasing like 'no infra required'. 'no infra to manage' is safer and keeps Dedicated/Private differentiation.

nate_product: Agree with Sarah. For benchmark line under hero: keep it non-technical — e.g. 'Industry-leading p95 latency for production workloads' with a link to benchmarks page.

olivia_sales: Lead routing: HubSpot form must pass `demo_type` = Hosted | Dedicated | Private. Routing plan: Hosted -> marketing nurture; Dedicated -> `dedicated-inbound` AE queue (tag SLA); Private -> `enterprise-inbound` + security flag.

alex_growth: @olivia_sales paste exact form mapping so eng/docs can wire it.

olivia_sales: mapping snippet below:
```
formField: demo_type
values: Hosted | Dedicated | Private
workflow: Hosted -> marketing-nurture; Dedicated -> dedicated-inbound; Private -> enterprise-inbound
tagging: Dedicated -> 'reserved-capacity'; Private -> 'vpc-private'
hiddenField: lead_score=high for Dedicated/Private
```

ben_design: Quick nit: hero imagery suggestions — Hosted: dev flow / API usage; Dedicated: capacity pools / GPU racks; Private: network diagram / secured deployment.

sarah_content: Webinar hook idea: 'Serving LLMs at scale: cost, latency, and predictable inference' — technical + case study. 30 min + 15 Q&A. Use as gated content to drive Dedicated interest.

nate_product: We'll need a two-sentence benchmark narrative near CTA: 'Redwood reduces per-token cost and delivers predictable p95 latency through smart batching, caching, and optimized kernels.' Keep non-numeric on landing.

emily_seo: Meta-description suggestion: 'Redwood Inference — hosted, dedicated, and private LLM inference with predictable performance, cost controls, and enterprise-grade security.'

alex_growth: Final asks: 1) pick Hosted hero (A/B) 2) approve CTA defaults 3) confirm form mapping 4) greenlight webinar hook

ben_design: Hosted B ✅ CTA defaults ✅ will push hero comps by EOD.

sarah_content: Copy tweak approved — use 'no infra to manage' per Emily.

olivia_sales: Form mapping confirmed. Added hidden `lead_score=high` for Dedicated/Private.

nate_product: Webinar hook approved. I'll own benchmark slide + one customer example.

emily_seo: Meta-desc approved. Also request canonical URL decisions for variants so we don't create duplicate content.

alex_growth: Great — I'll update staging content + HubSpot mapping. Plan: merge Friday 09:00 UTC, last checks by Thursday 15:00. Will announce in #marketing-launch when live. Thanks all :rocket: 

chad_ops_bot: Reminder: deployment freeze Thursday 22:00-06:00 UTC. If merging staging into prod, schedule outside freeze.

alex_growth: Noted — scheduling for Friday 09:00 UTC. Last checks Thursday 15:00.
